Island 2.2, landmark (b): masked language modelling validated

A batch of lines, each with one piece hidden, goes into the untrained model, a ghost. The same lines come back with its guesses: green where it guessed right, red where it guessed wrong. The red ones send a correction back, down the right and round between the rows, onto TransBERT-bio-fr, whose network lights up where it lands. The same batch through it comes back all green. No text is drawn. concepts · masked language modelling
